title: the WSG climbing checks - Table 16 (the modifiers to the non-thief's climbing rating)
audit_label: R436 WSG climbing checks pin audit
audit_comment: The climbing-checks slice pins Table 16 (the 13 surface rows x the three condition modifiers to the non-thief Climbing Rating) with the 100 percent no-fall and 5 percent floor rules, the other modifiers (the encumbrance, race, armor, strength and hands rules), the thief modifiers (the +30 auto rule, the double and quadruple falling chances) and the initial, intermediate and final check rules (rules/wsgcheck.h, prefix wck); census 360 -> 361.

banner.title: The WSG CLIMBING CHECKS, R436: Table 16 (the modifiers to the non-thief Climbing Rating - the same 13 surface rows as Table 15 x the non-slippery, slightly slippery and slippery adjustments, from the +70 rough gentle non-slippery bonus down to the -50 cliff smooth no-ledges slippery penalty) with the prose rules: the modifier is added to the non-thief Climbing Rating, a final rating of 100 percent or greater means no chance of falling and a final rating of 5 percent or lower is treated as 5 percent; the other modifiers (encumbrance: moderate -5, heavy -10, severe -20; race: dwarf -5, gnome -10, halfling -5, half-orc +5; armor: chain/splint/scale/banded -15, studded leather or padded -5, anything heavier than chain cannot climb a severe slope or cliff and climbs all else at -20; strength: +5 per full point over 15 on severe slopes or cliffs only, exceptional as 18; hands: both hands free on severe slopes and cliffs, one hand at -5 on a moderate slope, gentle slopes never need hands); the thief modifiers (a +30 or greater Table 16 value needs no check, the slightly slippery falling chance is doubled, the slippery chance quadrupled, the 5 percent floor shared); and the climbing checks (the 10-foot Initial Check - failure falls back to the start; the optional Intermediate Check past 100 feet or on smooth, slippery or severe surfaces, always recommended when traveling laterally, brief lateral stretches ignored; the always-made Final Check at the start of the completing round at +20 - failure falls to the bottom on a severe slope or cliff, and a same-round initial check stands alone with no bonus) - the round continues the movement-across-special-terrain section. Census 360 -> 361.
banner.provenance: the WSG scan (archive.org item pdfy-B3Fz83tZ3TV7zOc8), printed p. 35; the user own copy OCR cross-checked against the archive djvu word layer (nine of thirteen rows clean; the normal moderate, normal severe and both cliff smooth rows are absent from the djvu text layer and the smooth gentle row is garbled there) and the IIIF full-resolution eye-reads (four independent reads of the disputed rows - every value matched the user copy exactly: +50/+25/+10, +30/+15/+0, -10/-25/-40, -20/-35/-50).
banner.sentinel: The Table 16 numbers are percentage modifiers added to a non-thief Climbing Rating by the three conditions of the surface; the same 13 surface rows as Table 15. A final rating of 100 percent or greater means no chance of falling; a final rating of 5 percent or lower is treated as 5 percent. The Final Climbing Check is made at a +20 percent modifier.

consts.name: wckSurfaceCount
consts.comment: The Table 16 surface-row count - the same 13 surface rows as Table 15 (the nine slope rows and the four cliff rows).

consts.name: wckNoFallRating
consts.comment: A final adjusted Climbing Rating of 100 percent or greater means the surface is negotiated with no chance of falling.

consts.name: wckMinRatingFloor
consts.comment: A final adjusted Climbing Rating of 5 percent or lower (when the character is not specifically prohibited from the surface) is treated as 5 percent.

consts.name: wckThiefAutoThreshold
consts.comment: A thief traveling across terrain with a Table 16 value of +30 or greater needs no Climbing Check at all.

consts.name: wckThiefFallMultSlightly
consts.comment: On a slightly slippery surface a thief chance of falling is twice as great as on a nonslippery surface.

consts.name: wckThiefFallMultSlippery
consts.comment: On a slippery surface a thief chance of falling is four times as great as on a nonslippery surface.

consts.name: wckThiefScoreFloor
consts.comment: A thief climb walls score can never be less than 5 percent as the result of the slippery modifiers.

consts.name: wckEncModeratePenalty
consts.comment: The climbing rating encumbrance penalty for a moderate load.

consts.name: wckEncHeavyPenalty
consts.comment: The climbing rating encumbrance penalty for a heavy load.

consts.name: wckEncSeverePenalty
consts.comment: The climbing rating encumbrance penalty for a severe load.

consts.name: wckDwarfPenalty
consts.comment: The dwarf climbing rating adjustment.

consts.name: wckGnomePenalty
consts.comment: The gnome climbing rating adjustment.

consts.name: wckHalflingPenalty
consts.comment: The halfling climbing rating adjustment.

consts.name: wckHalfOrcBonus
consts.comment: The half-orc climbing rating adjustment.

consts.name: wckChainArmorPenalty
consts.comment: The climbing rating penalty for chain, splint, scale or banded armor.

consts.name: wckStuddedArmorPenalty
consts.comment: The climbing rating penalty for studded leather or padded armor.

consts.name: wckHeavierThanChainPenalty
consts.comment: A character outfitted in anything heavier than chain mail climbs all surfaces other than severe slopes and cliffs at a 20 percent penalty.

consts.name: wckStrengthBonus
consts.comment: The strength climbing rating bonus per full point greater than 15, on severe slopes or cliffs only.

consts.name: wckStrengthBase
consts.comment: The strength bonus counts full points greater than 15; an exceptional score counts as 18.

consts.name: wckOneHandPenalty
consts.comment: Climbing a moderate slope with one hand holding a shield or weapon applies a 5 percent penalty to the Climbing Rating.

consts.name: wckCheckMinDistance
consts.comment: A Climbing Check is required to ascend or descend a non-horizontal surface when the total distance to be traveled is at least 10 feet.

consts.name: wckInitialCheckDistance
consts.comment: The Initial Climbing Check comes after traveling 10 feet from the start of the climb.

consts.name: wckIntermediateDistance
consts.comment: An Intermediate Climbing Check may be called for when the current ascent or descent covers a substantial distance - more than 100 feet.

consts.name: wckFinalCheckBonus
consts.comment: The Final Climbing Check is made with a +20 percent modifier to the Climbing Rating.

bools.name: wckModifierAddedToRating
bools.comment: The appropriate Table 16 number is added to the Climbing Rating for a non-thief when determining the chance of falling.

bools.name: wckEncLightNoPenalty
bools.comment: A light or no encumbrance applies no climbing rating penalty.

bools.name: wckRaceHumanNoAdjust
bools.comment: A human, elf or half-elf applies no climbing rating adjustment.

bools.name: wckHeavierThanChainNoSevereCliff
bools.comment: A character outfitted in anything heavier than chain mail cannot climb any severe slope or cliff.

bools.name: wckStrengthSevereCliffOnly
bools.comment: The strength bonus applies on severe slopes or cliffs only.

bools.name: wckStrengthExceptionalAs18
bools.comment: An exceptional strength score counts as 18 for the climbing bonus.

bools.name: wckBothHandsFreeSevereCliff
bools.comment: A character cannot climb a severe slope or cliff while carrying a shield and/or a weapon at the ready - both hands must be free to grip the surface.

bools.name: wckOneHandModeratePenalized
bools.comment: One hand can hold a shield or a weapon while climbing a moderate slope, at the one-hand penalty.

bools.name: wckGentleHandsFreeNotPenalized
bools.comment: It is not necessary to use one hands when climbing a gentle slope, and a character with both hands full is not penalized in such a case.

bools.name: wckThiefAutoAboveThreshold
bools.comment: A thief on terrain with a Table 16 value of +30 or greater automatically negotiates the surface - his natural ability needs no Climbing Check.

bools.name: wckThiefCheckBelowThreshold
bools.comment: Below the +30 threshold a thief must make a successful Climbing Check - rolling his climb walls score or lower on percentile dice - to keep from falling.

bools.name: wckThiefScoreFloorApplies
bools.comment: As with non-thieves Climbing Ratings, a thief climb walls score can never drop below the 5 percent floor from these modifiers - anyone who wants to try should be given a chance, if he feels lucky.

bools.name: wckInitialCheckRequired
bools.comment: A character who begins a climb must make a successful Initial Climbing Check after traveling 10 feet to be able to continue climbing.

bools.name: wckInitialFailBackToStart
bools.comment: Failure on the Initial Climbing Check indicates the character has fallen back to the point from which the climb started.

bools.name: wckIntermediateOptional
bools.comment: Depending on the length and difficulty of the climb, the DM may require an Intermediate Climbing Check at the midpoint of the current ascent or descent.

bools.name: wckIntermediateOver100Feet
bools.comment: The Intermediate Climbing Check may be called for when the current ascent or descent covers more than 100 feet.

bools.name: wckIntermediateSmoothSlipperySevere
bools.comment: The Intermediate Climbing Check may also be called for when the surface is smooth, slippery, severe, or a combination of those qualities.

bools.name: wckLateralAlwaysCheck
bools.comment: It is recommended an intermediate check always be made when a character is traveling laterally and any of the above conditions apply.

bools.name: wckLateralBriefIgnored
bools.comment: Brief stretches of lateral movement do not count for this determination, as long as the character principal direction is either up or down.

bools.name: wckFinalCheckAlways
bools.comment: A Final Climbing Check is always made at the beginning of the round in which the character will complete the climb if he does not fall.

bools.name: wckFinalFailFallsToBottom
bools.comment: Failure on the Final Climbing Check indicates the character has fallen - and if the fall occurs while on a severe slope or a cliff, he will not stop until he hits bottom.

bools.name: wckFinalSameRoundInitialOnly
bools.comment: If the distance of the climb and the movement rate put the Final Climbing Check in the same round as the Initial Climbing Check, then the initial check with no bonus applied is the only one that must be made.

examples.note: the extremes of Table 16: the rough gentle non-slippery +70 bonus and the cliff smooth no-ledges slippery -50 penalty
the worked no-fall case: the base 40 percent non-thief rating plus the +70 rough gentle modifier reaches 110, at or above the 100 percent no-fall rating
the thief auto rule: the +70 rough gentle non-slippery value is at or above the +30 threshold, so no Climbing Check is needed
the thief falling multipliers (twice on slightly slippery, four times on slippery) and the shared 5 percent floor
the final check +20 bonus equals four one-hand penalties (20) - both book values pinned in one expression
